hints.title: Trivial Adjacency Case
hints.text: If p is already a direct child of q, the tree structure remains completely unchanged.

hints.title: Ancestor Relationship Check
hints.text: Determine whether q lies within the subtree of p by running a depth-first traversal starting from p.

hints.title: Subtree Reparenting Transitions
hints.text: If q is in the subtree of p, promote q to replace p in the parent children list before attaching p as a child of q.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Parent map generation and path traversal inspect each tree edge in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Moving subtree p under its own descendant creates disconnected cycles if parent reassignments are missed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent mapping enables ancestor checks and child deletion in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling the cycle hazard when target q is inside subtree p.
